title: Information Technology Institute - overview
text: Egypt specializing in IT . ITI was established in 1993 by the Egyptian Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC). [ 1 ] It provides specialized software development programs to fresh graduates, as well as professional training programs and IT courses for the Egyptian government, ministries, and local decision support centers. [ 1 ] This supports the government 's objective of providing access and opportunity for all. ITI opened a second branch in Alexandria in 1996 [ 2 ]

title: Information Technology Institute - overview
text: ITI opened a second branch in Alexandria in 1996 [ 2 ] to create greater coverage of its services, and in September 2007 ITI opened two other branches in Assiut and Mansoura to maintain and assist in the spreading of its training services.
